_notes: ONE FRAME, HELD -- the rear-attached wake the brief asks for, drawn once and
played by a `still` layer rather than animated. A FOLDER rather than a bare PNG
because SpellVfxRecipeDriftTests matches a played path's LAST segment against
recipe filenames: `..._wake/f0` would present `f0` as its provenance and find no
CONTENT_CROP, and it changes what the layer's numbers mean. The delivery is
2172x724 with the drawing occupying (73, 103)-(2084, 497) -- a third of the
canvas is empty, most of it above and below. preserveAspect fits the whole CANVAS
into the box, so the dead margin would shrink the visible wake by a third and
leave it floating in the middle of its own box. Cropped to the content plus 8px,
the canvas aspect becomes the drawing's own, which is what the placement code
already assumes a frame's width over its height means.
NO PIVOT AND NO IMPACT POINT. A wake rides its core through place 'layer:core',
and a follower's position is its SOURCE's position plus the layer's own (dx, dy)
-- impactX/impactY never reach it. Where the thick end attaches is therefore
authored as dx in skills.json, against the rendered width, and stating a pivot
here as well would be a correction that does not happen.
Delivered with its own alpha, like the rest of the pack; keyed is false.
